title: Rav Acha of Hutzal
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He lived in Rav Ashi’s time, as in Keritot 13b: he had made a vow concerning his wife and came to Rav Ashi to release it; he said to him, “Go now and come tomorrow,” etc. In Beitzah 32b Ravina said to Rav Ashi: “Rav Acha of Hutzal told us that they plaster an oven for the Master on a festival,” etc.
